caption: The drawing depicts an 18th-century style gown without a visible wearer, shown from the front. The dress is composed of a fitted bodice with a deep, rounded neckline, and elbow-length sleeves that end with wide white lace ruffles. The gown is full-length with a wide, voluminous skirt that extends outward, suggesting the presence of panniers underneath. The fabric of the dress is light beige or cream in color, adorned with an intricate floral pattern in multiple colors including shades of blue, green, pink, red, and yellow. The floral motifs are distributed evenly across the dress, creating a continuous pattern over the entire garment. The dress is open down the front, revealing a matching underskirt with the same floral design. The drawing is rendered with delicate lines and shading, and the background is plain and untextured, putting full emphasis on the details and colors of the gown itself.
